component.name: Manifold Test App
component.summary: OpenGL scene with FPS counter and environment probes

description.p: A small Qt application for testing Manifold. It draws a spinning triangle with OpenGL and shows the frame rate and the OpenGL renderer in use, to check that graphics work inside a Manifold image.

Beside it are a file system browser, a view of the environment, mounts and identity of the process, the list of loaded shared libraries, and buttons to try the file dialog, URL opening, the clipboard and the D-Bus session bus.
